title: Incorrectly handled negative sizes when processing ProcXvShmPutImage requests in the X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and…
description: A vulnerability in X.Org xwayland before version 24.1.15 and X Server before version 21.1.26 allows local authenticated X clients to cause a crash or execute code by sending incorrectly handled negative sizes in ProcXvShmPutImage requests.
